notes: Draft night and pro careers. Every offseason runs a 224-pick draft league-wide: your picks get a Draft Night card on Home (round, slot, senior or early entry), with the top 10 and picks by conference. Your former players now have pro careers you can follow on the Program tab: rookie to starter to Pro Bowler, second contracts, retirements, with news as it happens. The Pro pitch in recruiting is now graded on the last four drafts at your position instead of raw prestige. New midweek event: a Pro Bowl alum comes back to campus on his bye week. Two new achievements: Day one (first-rounder) and No. 1 overall.
